description: RFC 8621 §4.2: maxBodyValueBytes MUST truncate so value does not exceed this number of OCTETS. apply_body_value_args() in email.rs lines 1128-1135 uses char_indices().take_while(|(i, _)| *i < limit) which includes any character whose start byte index is below limit. A multi-byte UTF-8 character (e.g. a 3-byte character) starting at byte index limit-1 will be included in the output, making the result up to (char_size - 1) = 2 bytes over the specified limit. Trigger: maxBodyValueBytes=3, body value is the 5-byte string "ab€" (a=byte 0, b=byte 1, €=bytes 2-4). The € starts at i=2 < 3, so it is included. Output is 5 bytes, exceeding the 3-byte limit.
title: maxBodyValueBytes truncation may exceed limit by up to char_size-1 bytes
